interpretation: 'It will go on to infinity, and the beings will be not only half as many again but more; for again it will be possible to deny this [the intermediate] in relation to the affirmation and the denial, and this will be something, for its substance is something different.' Read as a regress against the posited intermediate as a further being. Not formalized: the absurdity Aristotle draws (a multiplication of beings) has no determinate formal content beyond the posit, and a determinate version would need an added premise that each new intermediate is distinct from all earlier ones. It targets the intermediate, not withholding.
